quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: It's fine, I can wait — turnabout is fair play, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You might want to be careful while you deliver it. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't touch any elements, and don't take too big a step</color>, now.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You do have to be quick about it, though. Wallit's impatience is pretty well-known around here.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Come on, why isn't it here yet?

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Oh, it's finally here, is it? Thanks so much. Now, pass it to me real quick — I have work to do after this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yup, Wallit ordered some Fisherman's Toast today before heading off to the Stone Gate on the border between Mondstadt and Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Really, though, who orders take-out for finger food?

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Come on, come on! Why hasn't my order arrived yet?
